summary: A saved Tinker task checkpoint completes the continuous four-task sequence under every quality check. Fresh-layout navigation evaluation continues.
claim: Development preview. Selected task checkpoint 8 qualifies in the continuous four-task sequence; the parent misses a quality limit. Navigation training continues with a compact two-profile interface. No fresh-layout advantage is claimed yet.
uncertainty: One known training-layout navigation probe, one matched task-checkpoint development comparison and two shared-controller repair comparisons. These are development evidence. Final navigation and task layouts remain unopened.
training: 32 original navigation and 16 separate task/recovery optimizer updates are completed. Task checkpoint 8 was selected using actual uninterrupted development runs. The next navigation curriculum uses compact planner summaries and the direct/buffered controllers; its remaining 16 updates have not started.
memory: Source-verified past.dev recalls pass measured failures, research and replay allocation between application roles. A private-audience canary passed. Evaluation conclusions are pending.
execution: At this publication snapshot the ledger accounts for 332 physical attempts, 5.79 simulation wall hours including reservations, 48 completed or reserved optimizer updates, 2 Exa searches and 9 actual past.dev recalls. Physics concurrency is capped at three Modal and two local workers. Modeled costs are not invoices.
